paper.title_en: Photon sphere jet equivalence and the non-uniqueness of black-hole thermodynamics
paper.abstract_en: We examine whether scalar eikonal quasinormal-mode data determine black-hole thermodynamics. For static, spherically symmetric, asymptotically flat, nonextremal geometries, we prove that the formal fixed-overtone expansion of a neutral, minimally coupled, massless scalar through order $L^{-N}$ depends only on the $(2N+2)$ jet of the lapse at the unstable photon sphere. For every finite $N$, real-analytic deformations can preserve this jet and the asymptotic Reissner--Nordström coefficients while changing the surface gravity and Hawking temperature. We also construct a nonanalytic $C^\infty$ deformation that is flat at the photon sphere. This deformation preserves the complete formal eikonal series to every algebraic order but changes the horizon position, temperature, and Einstein area entropy. A nonempty charged subfamily satisfies the weak energy condition as an effective Einstein source. Together, these four results establish the new finite-jet and all-orders thermodynamic obstruction. To separate geometric information from action-dependent information, we incorporate a previously established Reissner--Nordström--MOG comparison. The mapped backgrounds have identical normalized metrics, neutral-scalar boundary-value problems, exact scalar spectra, and Hawking temperatures, yet their Wald entropies differ because their curvature couplings differ. The resulting hierarchy shows that local photon-sphere data do not determine horizon thermodynamics and that even exact action-blind scalar data do not determine gravitational entropy. Agreement of the formal eikonal expansions for the deformed metrics does not imply exact finite-$\ell$ isospectrality. Global differences may appear beyond every algebraic order. Thermodynamic reconstruction from eikonal ringdown is therefore conditional on assumptions about the global metric and the gravitational action.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文直接探讨黑洞热力学与光子球/标量 eikonal 准正规模数据的可重构性，提出有限阶与全阶热力学障碍，并把几何信息与作用量相关信息区分开来；理论深度高、论证结构明确，对黑洞热力学与引力理论基础方向具有较强阅读价值。
decision.title_zh: 光子球喷流等价性与黑洞热力学的非唯一性
decision.abstract_zh: 我们考察标量 eikonal 准正规模数据是否决定黑洞热力学。对于静态、球对称、渐近平坦、非极端几何，我们证明中性、最小耦合、无质量标量的形式固定泛音展开到 $L^{-N}$ 阶仅依赖于不稳定光子球处 lapse 的 $(2N+2)$ 阶 jet。对于每个有限 $N$，实解析形变可以保持该 jet 以及渐近 Reissner--Nordström 系数，同时改变表面引力和霍金温度。我们还构造了一个在光子球处平坦的非解析 $C^\infty$ 形变。该形变在每一个代数阶上保持完整的形式 eikonal 级数，但改变视界位置、温度和 Einstein 面积熵。一个非空的带电子族作为有效 Einstein 源满足弱能量条件。这些结果共同确立了新的有限 jet 与全阶热力学障碍。为了把几何信息与依赖作用量的信息分离开来，我们引入此前已建立的 Reissner--Nordström--MOG 比较。映射后的背景具有相同的归一化度规、中性标量边值问题、精确标量谱和霍金温度，然而它们的 Wald 熵不同，因为其曲率耦合不同。由此得到的层级结构表明，局部光子球数据不能决定视界热力学，而且即使精确的作用量盲标量数据也不能决定引力熵。形变度规的形式 eikonal 展开一致并不意味着精确的有限-$\ell$ 等谱性。全局差异可能出现在每一个代数阶之外。因此，从 eikonal 铃宕进行热力学重构依赖于关于全局度规和引力作用量的假设。
